content.short: DragonSwap is a high-performance DEX on Sei V2 featuring concentrated liquidity and optimized trade execution for all.
content.description: DragonSwap is a leading decentralized exchange built on Sei V2, the first parallelized EVM blockchain, designed to offer ultra-fast trade execution and deep liquidity. The platform utilizes a concentrated liquidity model that allows liquidity providers to allocate capital within specific price ranges, significantly improving efficiency and reducing slippage. Powered by the DRG token, DragonSwap integrates features like limit orders and optimized routing to provide a professional-grade trading experience. As a core Sei component, it leverages sub-second finality and high throughput to deliver a seamless and scalable DeFi solution for modern traders.
